description:
Synthesizes a tailored statutory legal document suite (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Cookie Policy, EULA, Acceptable Use Policy, Disclaimer, Return Policy, Accessibility Statement) from answers gathered against the standardized 'get_questionnaire_schema' intake form.

When to use vs. related tools: Pair 'get_questionnaire_schema' -> 'generate_docs_questionnaire' in conversational intake workflows where you collect structured business, tracker, minor-protection, and retention answers from a user before drafting documents. For direct programmatic generation without a questionnaire UI step, 'generate_documents' accepts the exact same payload.

Preconditions & side effects: Requires 'company_name', 'website_url', and 'contact_email'. If 'siteId' is omitted, creates an isolated ephemeral tenant output with no registry mutation. If 'siteId' is explicitly supplied, it must match a registered site and will persist 'documents' and upgrade the site's compliance grade to 'A+'.

Returns: JSON object with 'success', 'siteId', 'company_name', 'tenant_mode', 'documents_generated', full 'documents' array, and 'message' (or 'error').

collects_cookies.description: Whether the website stores cookies, localStorage, or similar client identifiers.

collects_minors.description: Whether services are directed at or knowingly collect data from minors under 13/16 (activates COPPA & GDPR Art. 8 parental consent clauses).

company_name.description: Full legal entity or registered company name inserted as the Data Controller / Contracting Party.

contact_email.description: Public legal, support, and DSAR privacy contact email address printed inside the policies.

data_retention_months.description: Standard personal data retention duration in months disclosed in the Privacy Policy.

document_types.description: Subset of statutory documents to synthesize. Omit to generate the default 6-document suite (privacy_policy, terms_of_service, cookie_policy, eula, acceptable_use, disclaimer).

dpo_email.description: Optional dedicated Data Protection Officer (DPO) email address referenced in the Privacy Policy user-rights section.

has_user_accounts.description: Whether end-users can create authenticated accounts or user profiles.

jurisdictions.description: Regulatory regimes to incorporate into governing law, consumer rights, and AI disclosure clauses (e.g. 'GDPR', 'CCPA', 'UK_GDPR', 'PIPEDA', 'EU_AI_ACT').

physical_address.description: Registered corporate mailing address for statutory notices and controller identification.

processes_payments.description: Whether payments or recurring subscriptions are processed (adds billing, Stripe sub-processor, and refund sections).

refund_period_days.description: Consumer refund / withdrawal guarantee window in calendar days used in Terms of Service and Return Policy.

siteId.description: Optional registered site UUID (from 'list_sites' or 'add_site'). When provided and found, generated documents are persisted to that site's record and raise its compliance grade to A+. When omitted, documents are synthesized for an isolated ephemeral tenant ID without modifying registered sites.

uses_google_analytics.description: Whether Google Analytics 4 or Google Tag Manager is included in the sub-processor disclosures.

uses_hotjar.description: Whether Hotjar session recording or heatmap telemetry is disclosed in the Privacy Policy sub-processor section.

uses_meta_pixel.description: Whether Meta (Facebook) advertising pixels are active and must be disclosed under GDPR/CCPA.

website_url.description: Canonical HTTP or HTTPS URL of the website covered by the generated legal documents.

name: generate_docs_questionnaire

outputSchema.description: Result of synthesizing statutory legal documents, including either persisted or ephemeral tenant metadata and full Markdown documents.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when an explicit siteId does not match.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

company_name.description: Legal entity name used in generated clauses.

documents.description: Complete generated documents including Markdown bodies.

markdown.description: Complete policy content in Markdown format.

word_count.description: Total word count of the Markdown body.

documents_generated.description: Summary list of generated documents with preview links.

items.description: Summary entry for one generated legal document.

preview_url.description: Direct Paperloo viewer URL for the document.

word_count.description: Total word count of the synthesized document.

error.description: Validation or lookup error message when success is false.

siteId.description: Target registered siteId or generated ephemeral 'site_temp_*' identifier.

success.description: True if document generation succeeded; false if siteId lookup or required field validation failed.

tenant_mode.description: Indicates whether generated documents were saved to a registered site or returned for an isolated ephemeral tenant.

title: Synthesize Legal Docs from Questionnaire Answers
